question: Should OpenClaw add public persisted rootSessionKey and session-chain traceId fields for spawned sessions, and should traceId be a new chain id or bridge existing diagnostic trace context?
rationale: The code change is bounded, but rootSessionKey and traceId would become persisted session and Gateway API contract fields, so automation should not choose the permanent API semantics.

options.title: Add Minimal Spawn-Chain Contract
options.body: Add optional parent/root/trace/depth semantics for spawned sessions only, with additive schema, projections, docs, and focused tests while leaving traversal APIs for later.

options.title: Defer To Resolver Lineage Direction
options.body: Keep this open until sessions.resolve lineage semantics are settled, then align spawned-session metadata with that broader contract.

options.title: Reject Durable Root/Trace Fields
options.body: Keep the current parent/depth behavior and narrow future work to docs or tooling if maintainers do not want a durable chain identifier.

recommendation.title: Add Minimal Spawn-Chain Contract
recommendation.body: Add optional parent/root/trace/depth semantics for spawned sessions only, with additive schema, projections, docs, and focused tests while leaving traversal APIs for later.
